picks.title: Former Infosys chief has a new startup that wants to challenge the IT services world
picks.why_it_matters: Serial enterprise founder Vishal Sikka launching a new venture with top-tier backing (Mayfield, Aramco Ventures) signals a potential disruption opportunity in the massive IT services market worth watching for adjacent startup plays.

picks.title: OpenAI unveils its first custom chip, built by Broadcom
picks.why_it_matters: OpenAI's vertical integration into custom silicon reshapes the AI infrastructure stack and creates new opportunities for startups building tooling, optimization layers, or alternative compute solutions around emerging AI chip architectures.

picks.title: Qualcomm to Acquire Modular
picks.why_it_matters: A major exit for an AI infrastructure startup validates the market for developer tooling/compiler optimization plays and signals strategic acquirers are paying premium prices for teams that can accelerate AI deployment on edge devices.
